Carlos Mateo Jurado Díaz

Bioengineer with a Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence and a robust track record in neuromodulation and clinical technical support. My professional experience is anchored in the high-complexity medical device sector, specifically providing on-site technical assistance for Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) procedures. In this clinical role, I ensure the precision and safety of StealthStation S8 and Guideline 5 systems during surgery, as well as the post-operative programming of neurostimulators.

Complementing my clinical expertise, I have a strong background in research and technological development. Through my academic projects, I have implemented machine learning solutions for mental health data analysis and designed biomedical hardware, leveraging skills in Python and signal processing. As a founding member of the Colombian Society of Neuromodulation (SCON) and member of the International Neuromodulation Society (INS), I am committed to advancing medical technology standards. I possess valid visas for the United States and Canada, facilitating international mobility for business travel and professional training.
